recommendation: Keep the no-change audit as-is. Revisit only if FHIR-I makes a new decision to require explicit model-qualified type names in examples rather than allowing the documented default-FHIR shorthand.
issue_request: FHIR-27140 is a Published/Persuasive with Modification FHIR-core issue for the Mapping Language. It requested documenting that the cast transform's optional type parameter should include target model information, with a suggested tutorial example changing cast(a, "integer") to cast(a, "FHIR.integer"). The accepted resolution instead said to indicate that the default namespace is FHIR.
initial_application: The explicit FHIR-27140 implementation commit 785ebcfdb1c26d2ac12b886c84da6e8a341d4d0d updated source/structuremap/codesystem-map-transform.xml to add the default-FHIR namespace sentence to the cast transform definition. Later commit 662229e4296562444046aeac9c485f03292d1a34, for FHIR-20846 transform/FHIRPath alignment, propagated the same sentence into source/mapping-language.html and retained it in the CodeSystem definition.
additional_context: FHIR-I minutes from 2020-08-24 confirm the work group decision: add a sentence about defaulting to FHIR if unspecified. source/hierarchy.xml includes mapping-language.html and mapping-tutorial.html in the Implementation Support module. The tutorial still uses cast(a, "integer"), but that is consistent shorthand under the documented default-FHIR rule. Community and Jira searches found no later conflicting decision.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. No source change is needed because source/mapping-language.html and source/structuremap/codesystem-map-transform.xml already convey the approved default-FHIR behavior in current build-scope source.
